title: Inverted Clamp FISH Ligation Protocol
author: Benjamin Emert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qnkdvcw
materials: NEB Monarch PCR and DNA cleanup kit
Column purify using NEB Monarch PCR and DNA cleanup kit according to the manufacturer's instructions. Use 1 column per 10μL ligation reactions.
Rotate column 180º then centrifuge again. 00:01:00, Centrifuge at 16,000 x g. Probably carry-over superstition from using Qiagen columns.
Column purify using NEB Monarch PCR and DNA cleanup kit according to the manufacturer's instructions. Use 1 column per 10μL ligation reactions.

steps.title: Reconstitute Oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Reconstitute invertedClampFISH arms, backbones, and adaptors to 400uM in nuclease free water.

substeps.instruction: If the quantity of backbone oligos is very low, reconstitute to 200uM and use twice as much for subsequent reactions.

steps.title: Phosphorylate Backbone Oligos
steps.instruction: Combine reaction components to phosphorylate unmodified backbone oligos using a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Combine 2x T7 DNA ligase buffer, 400uM backbone oligo, T4 polynucleotide kinase (PNK), and nuclease free water.
Incubate the PNK reaction for 8 hours (or shorter, or overnight).
Note: If adding the same arms to each backbone oligo, multiple backbone oligos can be phosphorylated and ligated simultaneously (up to 30 probes, scaling reaction 2x-3x).

steps.title: Prepare Arm and Adapter Mix
steps.instruction: Combine the following reaction components: 400μM left arm, 400μM right arm, 400μM left adapter, and 400μM right adapter.

steps.title: Denature and Anneal Components
steps.instruction: Heat the reaction components to 95ºC for 5 minutes on a thermal cycler, then cool slowly to 12ºC at a rate of 0.1ºC/sec.

steps.title: Ligate Components
steps.instruction: Perform ligation of the components at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Bring the reaction to room temperature and add T7 DNA ligase.
Mix the reaction and centrifuge.
Incubate at room temperature overnight (12:00:00).
If any oligos contain a dye, incubate in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare for Column Purification
steps.instruction: Adjust the ligation reaction volume for purification using nuclease free water and binding buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 μL nuclease free water to the ligation reaction.
Add 350 μL binding buffer.
Note: Scale volumes as needed, ensuring 7x volume of binding buffer is added before loading; a total volume of 200 μL per column is recommended.

steps.title: Purify Probes via Monarch Column
steps.instruction: Purify the ligated probes using a Monarch DNA column and centrifuge at 16,000 x g.

substeps.instruction: Apply the reaction to the Monarch column and spin down for 1 minute.
Remove flow-through and apply 200 μL Monarch DNA wash buffer; spin down for 1 minute.
Repeat the wash with another 200 μL Monarch DNA wash buffer and spin down for 1 minute (flow-through removal between washes is not required).
Transfer the column to a clean centrifuge tube and spin down for 1 minute to remove residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute and Quantify Probes
steps.instruction: Elute the purified probes and measure the final concentration.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean centrifuge tube for elution.
Apply 30uL nuclease-free water to the column (volume can be scaled to adjust final concentration).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 minute to elute probes.
Measure concentration using a Nanodrop, setting the absorbance constant to 33 for ssDNA (expected final concentration 50-80ng/μL with 30 μL elution).
